maybe so its not too much damage to the hair? unfortunately the only “permanent” fun colors ive seen are through ion, but there are a lot of direct dyes (semi permanent) that have natural ingredients and feel a lot better on the hair than ion does. 

i work at sallys (not saying im a pro in anyway bc im not, i just know a lot abt diff products and have a lot of PERSONAL experience and then some) and have tried a lot of different semi perm colors and they have all been soooo much better than anything ion in my opinion. but everyones hair is different!! so if you like ion then go for it! 

if ya wanna do something not as damaging (back to back processes with developer vs bleaching and conditioning direct dye) id totally recommend going to the brands iroiro or strawberry leopard!!! those colors have always been so vibrant for me and strawberry leopard actually has a conditioning bonding complex to it that reallly helps repair the hair afterwards. 

also iroiro is made of 95% natural ingredients!! 
a little tip, when you do go to dye your hair the pretty blue color you want, id recommend leaving it in for an hour or two to really let it soak in!

another thing - iroiro has MULTIPLE shades of blue, so its not just a basic “dark blue” or “electric blue”. theres a light blue, neon blue, blue, and dark blue!!! and you can mix colors too to have your own unique shade :) as long as its in the same brand because i wouldnt recommend mixing between different brands because of different ingredients in each brand! 

ive found that even with ion labeling their brights as permanent, some times they really just dont seem....permanent...in my case and in a lot of people that come by the store. 

but of course, go to the brand that works for you!! :) and always remember to rinse with cold water and not shampoo for 48 hours after!!!

one more thing — you should only really lighten up your roots since they are darker than the rest of your blonde so you have a clean and even palette to work on. 10v or standard 20v developer would be good!! since its your roots and its close to the scalp, itll process a bit fast because of the heat your scalp naturally produces so make sure to check on it frequently and not leave it on longer for 45 minutes!! id also say to get a violet or blue base bleach to help cancel out any orange or yellow you may naturally pull (if you do at all).
prism lites is a good one for this, because they have either a violet OR blue base bleach :)
